boot_units.import_unit:
[Unit]
Description=Disposable ZFS crypto compatibility test pool import
After=zfs-import.target
Before=kasa-zfs-unlock-test.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/zpool import -N -d /var/tmp/kasa-zfs-unlock-test-20260913 kasa_unlock_test_20260913
boot_units.unlock_unit:
[Unit]
Description=Disposable ZFS crypto unlock boot compatibility test
Requires=kasa-zfs-unlock-test-import.service
After=zfs-import.target zfs-mount.service kasa-zfs-unlock-test-import.service
Before=pve-guests.service
RequiresMountsFor=/var/tmp/kasa-zfs-unlock-test-20260913
[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/bin/bash /var/tmp/kasa-zfs-unlock-test-20260913/zfs_crypto_unlock.sh
ExecStartPost=/usr/bin/udevadm settle --timeout=30
ExecStartPost=/bin/bash /var/tmp/kasa-zfs-unlock-test-20260913/proxmox-verify.sh kasa_unlock_test_20260913/canmount-off kasa_unlock_test_20260913/filesystem
TimeoutStartSec=60
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
